name: tachylite
description: A light Electron markdown and MDC viewer with editable preview, split, and raw modes.

scripts.check: node --check main.js && node --check preload.js && node --check renderer/app.js
scripts.pack:asar: rm -rf /tmp/tachylite-asar-build /tmp/tachylite-app.asar && mkdir -p /tmp/tachylite-asar-build && rsync -a --exclude .git --exclude .gitignore --exclude README.md --exclude package-lock.json --exclude 'node_modules/**/test/' --exclude 'node_modules/**/tests/' --exclude 'node_modules/**/.yarn/' --exclude 'node_modules/**/*.map' --exclude 'node_modules/**/src/' ./ /tmp/tachylite-asar-build/ && npx --yes @electron/asar pack /tmp/tachylite-asar-build /tmp/tachylite-app.asar
